_comment: Inline policy for the gamut-box role (EC2 instance profile). S3 statement = the August permissions; the EC2 statement adds what fleet_userdata_spotnp.sh (tag/EIP) and box_autoteardown.sh (self-teardown) need. Paste as an inline policy named gamut-box-policy when recreating the role. Replace <ACCT> with the account id if the bucket name changed.
